items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 35:1
items.html: (To the question) Because these Mochin of midnight are the illumination of AB SAG, which lowers the bottom Hey from the openings of the eyes to the mouth, and returns the AHP to the degree, through which the vessels are completed. However, how will Rachel receive these Mochin, while she does not yet have her AHP, since she still has no aspect of Yesod, to which the bottom Hey will descend? Therefore Rachel herself cannot couple now at night, but Leah couples with ZA and takes these Mochin, of the lowering of the bottom Hey from the eyes, from the upper Aba and Ima, through which the point of the chest descends to the place of the Yesod, and new NHY are clarified from BYA, which are the nine of Rachel that connect to her Keter, and she is completed there in Beriah from the aspect of the illumination of vessels; and afterwards, by day, she ascends with the vessels to Atzilut and becomes a complete Partzuf in a stature equal to ZA, face-to-face. And it is found that in truth also the coupling of the night is for the need of Rachel, namely, to raise her nine from Beriah, as above; only that Rachel is not yet ready for coupling, because she then has only body and eye and lacks AHP, and therefore Leah serves in her place. (Part 1, Page 506, s.v. "however").
